    Format APA results for validation pipeline

    format_apa_for_validation.Rd

    Converts the output of parse_apa_text() into a data frame structure compatible with validate_references(). It adds necessary columns such as ref_n, source_file, and authors_list (parsed from the string).

    Usage

    format_apa_for_validation(apa_data, source_file = "APA_Input")

    Arguments

    apa_data

    A data frame returned by parse_apa_text().

    source_file

    Optional character string indicating the source file name. Defaults to "APA_Input".

    Value

    A tibble/data.frame with columns: title, doi, year, authors, authors_list, ref_n, source_file.

    See also

    check_doi_exists() to validate the existence of an extracted DOI, validate_references() for the full reference validation pipeline via OpenAlex/DOI.
